note: One swing of a unit's own weapon: what it is aimed at, when it lands, and the missile it throws.

fields.name: target
fields.note: The unit swung at. Nothing observed carries zero here.

fields.name: timing
fields.note: How the swing sits against the unit's own rhythm. It is 128 in everything observed.

fields.name: missile
fields.note: The name the missile this swing throws will answer to.

fields.name: slot
fields.note: Which of the unit's attacks this is.

fields.name: targetX
fields.note: Where the unit swung at stands, along one ground axis. Carried in the units a path uses rather than in world units, and whole in everything observed. spec/movement.md says how the two relate.

fields.name: targetY
fields.note: Where it stands, in height. Carried in world units.

fields.name: targetZ
fields.note: Where it stands, along the other ground axis. It shares the reading of the first.
